title: Construction of the Parakrama Samudra reservoir
summary: The Parakrama Samudra, the Sea of Parakrama, is a large irrigation reservoir at Polonnaruwa in Sri Lanka. The Central Cultural Fund says King Parakramabahu the Great built it to crown his earlier engineering feats, in the golden age of the Polonnaruwa kingdom. His reign is given as 1153 to 1186, and the Columbia Encyclopedia says he encouraged an efficient irrigation system.

uncertainty.note: No opened page dates the reservoir's construction itself; the range is the reign of the king credited with it.
